summary: Frontend-only PWA app-shell refactor validation per round-44 request. Verified against live preview URL at mobile viewport 390x844 (iPhone UA via CDP override) and desktop 1280x800. ALL 6 acceptance groups pass: (1) PWA mode (?source=pwa): html.classList contains 'pwa' TRUE; scrolling #site-scroll to 800 keeps window.scrollY=0 and header.getBoundingClientRect().top=0; back-to-top button appears and scrolls #site-scroll back to 0; a2hs-tip NOT visible within 5s. (2) PWA product->checkout flow: product-card click opens detail with #site-scroll.scrollTop=0; mobile-add-to-cart-btn adds item and auto-opens cart drawer; /checkout renders inside #site-scroll with header top=0 (empty-cart state so scrollable content short - not a bug); browser back returns to home with scrollTop=0 and header still at top. (3) PWA login modal: clicking header-signin-btn adds body.className='gt-scroll-locked'; typing in dialog input works; closing modal removes gt-scroll-locked and #site-scroll remains scrollable (scrollTop=300 after test). (4) Browser mode (no ?source=pwa, iPhone UA, fresh sessionStorage): html.classList NO 'pwa'; window.scrollY=600 after scroll; header position=sticky, top=0 while scrolled; a2hs-tip appears after ~3s, close button hides it, navigating to product + back does NOT re-show it. (5) Desktop 1280x800: PagedGrid cat-paged-livestream mouse-drag changes inner scrollLeft 0->556; dot buttons dot-0/dot-1 drive scrollLeft 0 and 556 correctly; footer visible at viewport bottom; zero console errors. (6) /manifest.json start_url='/?source=pwa', icons include 192x192 AND 512x512, /icons/app-icon-192.png returns HTTP 200 content-type image/png (52552 bytes). No layout breakage, no double scrollbars, no console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx PagedGrid L359: the data-testid is on the OUTER wrapper div while the actual scroll element is the inner div (ref.current). The problem spec said 'cat-paged-* mouse-dragged -> scrollLeft changes', but scrollLeft actually lives on the inner child. Minor DX issue — tests that read scrollLeft on the testid'd element will see 0. Consider moving the data-testid to the ref div, or exposing a second testid like cat-paged-{id}-track.

Checkout page with empty cart renders a short empty state (scrollHeight==clientHeight==757), so there's no visible 'bottom action bar' and no scrolling to exercise. Not a bug but worth confirming the sticky bottom bar is present when cart has items; from the add-to-cart flow test the drawer intercepts navigation so couldn't be exercised end-to-end in-browser without force-navigate.
A2HSTip relies on both navigator.userAgent mobile check AND sessionStorage; works correctly but means desktop automated tests will never see it — documented in context_for_next_testing_agent.
test_credentials: N/A — guest flow, no login required.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. One cart item added transiently during PWA product flow test; not cleaned since cart is per-session/local.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To exercise a2hs-tip on an iPhone UA inside the shared Playwright context, use CDP: `client = await page.context.new_cdp_session(page); await client.send('Network.setUserAgentOverride', {'userAgent': '<iPhone UA>'})` BEFORE goto. A fresh context closed/reopen inside the mcp_browser_automation tool often fails to connect — stick with CDP UA override on the given page. Clear sessionStorage + localStorage['a2hs_tip_shown'] then reload to reset the once-per-session gate. For PagedGrid drag detection, select the FIRST child div of [data-testid=cat-paged-*] since the outer wrapper is non-scrollable (overflow:visible); the scroll container is the inner `.flex.overflow-x-auto` div holding ref. Checkout bottom action bar requires non-empty cart to appear.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; app-shell refactor is working correctly on both PWA and normal browser modes across mobile and desktop viewports.
